decision.rationale: Attempt 005 is invalid because the third Gemini batch violated a frozen semantic invariant. Preserve the result, revoke authorization, and do not infer reviewer or product quality from 8 accepted votes.
limitations: Only 8/40 Gemini votes were accepted, so no Gemini quality metric is valid.
The panel remains model-assisted silver evidence rather than independent human ground truth.
No 200-case panel, T0 product, visual, private-data, 600-case, or academic 10,000-case evidence was produced.
